setup: A regular spherical polygon has [[n]] equal angles of [[A]] degrees, and the question asks for its excess.

steps.say: The excess is the amount by which the angle sum of the polygon exceeds the flat total, and each angle contributes [[A]] degrees.
A flat polygon with [[n]] sides has angle sum ([[n]] - 2) times 180 degrees, and that sum is the baseline.
Subtracting the baseline from [[n]] times [[A]] leaves the excess in degrees.
